name: SparkLend

repos.scope: SparkLend is a direct Aave V3 fork (sparkdotfi/sparklend-v1-core forked from aave/aave-v3-core). The Aave V3 subgraph framework (factory/template) is the standard way SparkLend markets on Ethereum + Gnosis are indexed; community deployments of this template against the Spark Pool addresses serve the GraphQL endpoints referenced in Spark docs.
repos.verified: Confirmed sparklend-v1-core README states 'core smart contracts of the Aave V3 protocol' (fork). No first-party Spark subgraph repo exists in github.com/sparkdotfi (checked org repo list); indexing relies on the Aave V3 subgraph template applied to Spark Pool addresses.

notes: Aave V3 fork (MakerDAO/Sky subDAO) on Ethereum + Gnosis. No official Spark-owned subgraph repo; the sparkdotfi org has only contract/deployment/governance repos. Spark docs reference per-network subgraphs queried via The Graph; these are Aave-V3-template deployments. has_public_indexer=true via the reusable Aave V3 subgraph code.

name: Babylon Protocol

repos.scope: Official Babylon BTC-staking indexer: syncs delegation and finality-provider events from both the Babylon chain (BBN) and Bitcoin, stores in MongoDB, feeds the staking API.
repos.verified: WebFetched repo: Go (98.3%), 197 commits, 37 releases, latest v3.0.9 (2026-01-12). Description confirms it indexes Babylon BTC staking delegation + finality provider events. Official babylonlabs-io org.

repos.scope: Official API service consuming the staking-indexer's processed events (RabbitMQ queue + MongoDB) to serve staking data to the frontend.
repos.verified: Found in babylonlabs-io org alongside the indexer; companion API layer to babylon-staking-indexer per Babylon docs.

notes: Bitcoin staking protocol. Custom Go indexer rather than a subgraph (Bitcoin + Cosmos-SDK chain not EVM). Official, actively maintained.

name: BlackRock BUIDL
notes: Tokenized money-market fund issued via Securitize (custodial, permissioned transfer-agent token). No public protocol indexer/subgraph; data lives with Securitize. Token transfers are visible on standard explorers but no dedicated public BUIDL indexer repo exists. Low-priority custodial RWA.

name: JustLend
notes: TRON Compound-fork lending protocol. Open-sourced contracts (github.com/justlend/justlend-protocol, justlend-interface) but no public subgraph/indexer repo. TRON is not supported by The Graph hosted historically; recent Graph/Substreams TRON support is announced but no public JustLend-specific indexer repo found. Marked false (no verifiable public indexer repo).

name: Circle USYC
notes: Tokenized yield coin (formerly Hashnote USYC, now Circle). Custodial/permissioned RWA token. No public protocol subgraph/indexer repo. Low-priority custodial RWA.
